title: Local coefficient after pulling back a zero-locus morphism
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $M,N$ be invertible modules on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\varphi:M\to N$. If $U\subseteq X$ is affine with free generators $e_M,e_N$ and $\varphi(e_M)=b\,e_N$, and $V\subseteq Y$ is affine with $V\subseteq g^{-1}(U)$, then the pullback modules have free generators $e'_M,e'_N$ on $V$ and the pulled-back morphism satisfies $(g^*\varphi)(e'_M)=g.appLE\,U\,V\,b\;e'_N$ [def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: lemma IsFreeGenerator.exists_pullback, lines 388-446; specialized from the full inverse-image open to an affine open V

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-zero-scheme-pullback-full-local-coefficient] with $W=U$ to obtain free generators on $g^{-1}(U)$ and the coefficient $g.app\,U\,b$. Restrict both generators along the inclusion $V\subseteq g^{-1}(U)$; restriction of a free generator remains a free generator, and functoriality of restriction of sections gives the coefficient $g.appLE\,U\,V\,b$. Thus the asserted generators on $V$ satisfy the displayed equation.
